payload.title: Support explicit successful exit codes for managed developer commands
payload.summary: CommandResult currently treats every nonzero status as failure, while Git diff --no-index legitimately returns1 when differences are found. Add opt-in immutable per-Command success code interpretation across result/executor/Tool behavior, preserving default zero-only and raw execution facts.

discovery.reference: Codex supervised Qwen engineering14; maintained-source inspection and independently qualified actual Git diff fixture

payload.benefit: Both Qwen and Codex consumers can explicitly classify expected developer-tool statuses without scattering exit-code special cases or replacing managed execution.
payload.uncertainty: The local assignment defines a narrow opt-in classification contract; no generic policy, execution-error conversion, shell, retry or authority semantics follow. Parent reliability and protected-main adoption remain open.
dependencies: Existing immutable Command, CommandResult, CommandExecutor and ToolRunner/CommandTool; existing native coding and local closeout
